page.layout: One column of text on one printed page. Running head at top centre. Two titled sections, separated by an ornamental rule. Catchword at lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: QUIS EST UNDECIMUS Titulus?
De satisdationibus. Von bürgschafften zu recht.

head.i: Quid dicis de satisdatione secundum Jus Novum?

main_text.p: Sive quis in rem actione convenitur, sive persona-li suo nomine: nullam satisdationem pro litis aestimatione dare compellitur: sed pro sua tantum persona, quod in judicio permaneat usq; ad termi-num, vel committitur suae promissioni cum jureju-rando (quam juratoriam cautionem vocant, welches man einen geschwornen Vorstand oder Versicherung[?] nennet) vel nudam promissionem, vel satisdationem pro qualitate personae suae dare compellitur. §. sed hodie. inst. cod.
main_text.head: QUIS EST DUODECIMUS Titulus?
De perpetuis & temporalibus actionibus, & quae ad haeredes, & in haeredes transeunt. Von ewigen vnnd zeitlichen klagen / vnnd welche auff die erben beyderseits des klägers vnd beklagten kommen.
main_text.p: Quae ex lege, senatusve consultis, sive ex saeri[?] constitutionibus proficiscuntur. in prin inst. cod. Quae vero ex propria praetoris jurisdictione pendent, plerunque intra annum vivunt.in prin.inst.eod.

page.notes: The right edge of the scan is cut off: "saeri[?]" and the ends of some lines beyond "proficiscuntur" and "plerunque" may be incomplete. The catchword "Datürn" is partly cut off at the edge; read as "Datur[?]". In "welches man einen geschwornen ... nennet", the word before "nennet" is damaged where the type is broken; read as "Versicherung[?]". The German in the black letter section is marked as <bl>. The ornamental rule between the two sections is not text and is not transcribed.
